adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, the old explicit empty-hosts check (`SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.blank?`) was removed and replaced with a single referer-based check: `unless EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb). In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb`, the test "raises an error with a missing host" no longer sets any state (it removed `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil`) and also does not stub a referer, so it now fails for the same reason as the later "raises an error with no referer" test: `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(nil)` will be false, raising the same error path. Additionally, `expect(response).not_to be_success` does not distinguish the intended rejection mode/status. This makes the test name/intent no longer validated by the spec, but it’s a test coverage/clarity issue rather than a verifiable production defect in this diff.
